Name: Portable Furnaces
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod adds four tiers of portable furnaces that are craftable with sufficient mining level. Each teir has a different speed multiplier.

[list]
[*][b]Copper Furnace[/b] - req. Mining 2, 0.5x speed mult
[*][b]Iron Furnace[/b] - req. Mining 4, 0.7x speed mult
[*][b]Gold Furnace[/b] - req. Mining 6, 1x speed mult
[*][b]Iridium Furnace[/b] - req. Mining 8, 1.5x speed mult
[/list]

To use a furnace from the inventory menu, pick up ore, hover over the furnace and press the interact button like a normal furnace (for M/K it's Right Mouse Button).

To set a furnace to repeat the current smelting operation until running out of ore or coal, hover over the furnace in the inventory and press the repeat key (default [b]R[/b]).


[b][size=5]Config
[/size][/b]
You can change lots of things like the speed multipliers and skill requirements in the config.

This mod implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] menu for in-game config editing.

[/size][/b]
